xyz.refinedev.practice.api.leaderboard

Enum LeaderboardType

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<LeaderboardType>
      • xyz.refinedev.practice.api.leaderboard.LeaderboardType
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<LeaderboardType>

    public enum LeaderboardType
extends java.lang.Enum<LeaderboardType>
    Represents the different types of leaderboards in the system.

    Each type can be either local (per-kit) or global (across all kits). Global variants are automatically linked to their local counterparts via toGlobal() and toLocal(). The key represents the field in the database. E.g. "elo", "kills", "wins", "winstreak", "experience". If the type is local, it is fetched from the kit-specific IStatsCache from the database.

    Since:
